sentences.en: They eat the flea dirt left behind by the previous generation and finally have a full blood meal.

sentences.en: When we got to the vet, they did a full physical on Charley, full blood panel, and asked to keep him the rest of the day to observe him.

sentences.en: Donors receive a full blood panel, kidney check and basic physical exam at no charge.
sentences.vi: Những người hiến tặng sẽ nhận được toàn bộ bảng máu, kiểm tra thận và khám sức khỏe cơ bản miễn phí.

sentences.en: The conflict could escalate into a full-blooded war.

sentences.en: All of these initiatives stopped well short of full-blooded state intervention.

sentences.en: Experts are agreed that full-blooded market reform is the only way to save the economy.

sentences.en: So how did the full-blooded tabby pattern arise?
